text: i need to see the ghost before clicking not on click
resolution: The armed placement ghost in the loader iso pane only showed on click/drag, not on hover. Root cause: the host fires no passive mouse-move events (onMouseMove only during a drag), so the onMove-driven setSnap never ran while hovering — the ghost resolved only when a press generated events. Fixed by mirroring IsoAuthor's established approach: poll getMouseX/getMouseY every frame inside the pane's existing rAF/setTimeout loop, convert to pane-local pixels, and re-resolve+setSnap the ghost when the cursor is over the pane (skipping a live move-drag, and guarded by a cell-key so it only re-renders when the snapped target cell actually changes). The green ghost wireframe box now tracks the cursor before you click to place. TSX-only, hot-reloads; bundle resolves clean. Needs live confirmation in the dev host.
